note: ⛔ 這不是一份會被載入的 content 文件（`content/_legacy/` 不在 COLLECTION_NAMES 裡）。它是 41 位未上架英雄的 tint 保真度紀錄，跟著他們一起搬過來的。哪一位重新上架就把他那一條搬回 content/config/unit-tints.json。

Ecen.name: 姜窩肯
Ecen.evidence: INHERITED default: the map sets no tint mods, but Blizzard UnitUI.slk row Ecen (Keeper of the Grove) ships red=255 green=200 blue=255. The importer dropped this too because it never read the field. Verified by parsing Units\UnitUI.slk out of War3Patch.mpq.

N01B.name: 地獄歌神
N01B.evidence: war3map.w3u custom entry N01B (base Nman, same model): uclg=100 uclb=100. TASK #249: it is the 變身 ALTERNATE form of 憤怒的胖虎 (TRANSFORM_FORMS pair 40, ability A0ND 40-03 萬解-貓王胖虎, counterpart godie-nman which carries the same red). The champion doc did not exist when this row was written — 'second copy of 地獄歌神 with no champion doc' — and had to be imported once the transform primitive landed. Now mapped.

風魔小次郎 A030 飛燕 restore to white; godie-naka has no static tint, so no-op.
